name: GoHighLevel
one_liner: All-in-one CRM and marketing platform for agencies and businesses, with contacts, workflows, calendars and payments.
auth_notes: Two supported methods: OAuth 2.0 for Marketplace or user-authorized apps, and Private Integration Tokens (PIT) for internal single-account integrations. Legacy API keys are being phased out.
access_notes: API access is included in Starter ($97/month), Unlimited ($297/month) and Founder ($497/month) plans. PITs are created in Settings with no review stated. Some endpoints, such as Create Sub-Account, need the Founder plan.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve PIT or OAuth credentials on a paid plan, with a documented REST API and rate limits. Some endpoints need the Founder plan, and endpoint eligibility varies by plan.

identity.quote: HighLevel provides APIs that allow developers to build custom integrations, automate processes, and connect external applications with the HighLevel platform.

auth.quote: Private Integration Tokens allow developers to securely connect internal applications to HighLevel.
OAuth 2.0 allows applications to request authorized access to HighLevel accounts.

access.quote: HighLevel provides API access across Starter ($97/month), Unlimited ($297/month), and Founder ($497/month) plans.

api_surface.quote: The APIs support contacts, conversations, calendars, workflows, payments, webhooks, and more.
HighLevel applies rate limits to public API V2 requests using OAuth to maintain performance and stability.

mcp.quote: This is a BASE-LEVEL foundational project designed to connect the GoHighLevel community with AI automation through MCP (Model Context Protocol).
